description: This Java class defines a strategy for handling the ResetConnectionLogs command within the connectivity messaging persistence layer. It extends an abstract strategy, providing specific actions and response mechanisms for resetting connection logs.

classes.name: ResetConnectionLogsStrategy
classes.description: A final class that implements a strategy for handling ResetConnectionLogs commands, extending AbstractEphemeralStrategy specialized with ResetConnectionLogs.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns a response message indicating the current connection state, using headers passed as parameter.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns a list of actions to perform, specifically broadcasting to client actors if started and sending a response.
